paragraphs.text: The Speed Demon is a lesser demon of Duskmourn , released by Valgavoth to chaperone Winter . It races among the possessed and the damned as a demonic minder, the tormentor of the Speed Demons team captain, Winter .

The Speed Demon is the embodiment of vehicle death and speed , and a being of ravenous hunger. It was cursed and bound to Winter to forever act as his warden. As the co-leader and namesake of the Speed Demons, it demands sacrifice after sacrifice to satiate its endless need for speed.
